title: Writing a custom node with the V3 API

questions.q: Which two methods must a V3 node define?
How does ComfyUI find the nodes in a V3 pack?
options: It scans for classes named Node
It calls comfy_entrypoint, then get_node_list on the extension it returns
questions.answer: It calls comfy_entrypoint, then get_node_list on the extension it returns

questions.q: Why must a node not change an input tensor in place?
options: The same object may be cached and handed to other nodes
questions.answer: The same object may be cached and handed to other nodes
questions.why: A change in place corrupts the result for every other consumer and for the cache.

questions.q: What should validate_inputs return for a bad value?
questions.why: The contract is bool or str, per the type annotation in _io.py. The lab returns the string.

questions.q: Your node reads a file named by a widget, and the file changes on disk. What makes it rerun?
options: A fingerprint_inputs that returns the file's hash
questions.answer: A fingerprint_inputs that returns the file's hash
questions.why: The fingerprint joins the cache key, as CU-221 shows.
